newsitem.title: UK: Algeria lowers gas oil price in Jan - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria lowers gas oil price in Jan - trade.

text.p: State Algerian oil company Sonatrach has lowered its asking price for low sulphur gas oil to be delivered in January, traders said on Tuesday.
Sonatrach was looking for a discount of $1.50 to the formula, which is based on diesel prices in northern Europe and the Mediterranean, they said.
Sonatrach obtained a $2.50 premium to the formula in November and October.
Traders gave mixed reactions to the proposal, to which they are expected to reply later on Tuesday. Final agreements are expected to be concluded before the end of the month, they said.
"I think the level is acceptable to most contractors," one trader said. "We feel it is relevant to the market."

Another trader disagreed. "The price is too high, but it does show that Sonatrach is beginning to change its mind about where the market really is. We feel (a discount of) about $2.50 would be more realistic."

No deliveries were agreed in December, when Sonatrach proposed a premium of 50 cents to the formula without attracting buyer interest. It then lowered the premium to flat to the formula but again did not agree deliveries with contractors.
